name: Snow Hill circuit
summary: From the car park by the football ground across the field, through the Great Park to Snow Hill, down the Long Walk and back along the treeline. Firm park roads in the middle; a steep descent from Snow Hill.

start.label: Car park by Windsor & Eton FC (near Auntie Janis's)

notes: The first stretch crosses the field on a worn path that is not on the map. The usual alternative is along the treeline from the same field.
The Deer Park can be closed at short notice, and is closed in the evenings. Which gates are affected is not recorded yet.
Passes near Queen Anne's Ride, which the map marks as often closed in winter.

Recorded on foot on 9 Oct 2026 at about 5 km/h. The way back from the Long Walk was not recorded (the phone ran out); it follows the mapped paths along the treeline the walker described, through Queen Anne's Gate.

sources.label: EU-DEM 25 m terrain model via Open Topo Data
sources.attribution: Produced using Copernicus data and information funded by the European Union - EU-DEM layers
sources.limitation: 25 m grid: sustained slopes only; short ramps and kerbs are not visible, and buildings or trees can distort values in town.
